canonical.question: What ticket-amendment deadline and cancellation exception does the National Rail Advance ticket guidance give?
canonical.expected_primary: If you need to change the day or time that you are travelling, you can amend your ticket right up to the time your journey is due to begin.
canonical.expected_secondary: Advance tickets are non-refundable, unless your train is delayed or cancelled and you choose not to travel.
canonical.tampered_primary: You cannot amend an Advance ticket after booking under any circumstances.
